to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        if count is 0:
            say ""
        otherwise:
            let prefix be ask ""
            let remaining be count - 1
            repeat remaining times:
                let line be ask ""
                let prefix_characters be prefix split by ""
                let line_characters be line split by ""
                let next_prefix be an empty list of text
                let still_matching be yes
                for each index from 1 to length of prefix_characters:
                    if index is more than length of line_characters:
                        set still_matching to no
                    otherwise:
                        if item index of prefix_characters is not item index of line_characters:
                            set still_matching to no
                    if still_matching:
                        add item index of prefix_characters to next_prefix
                set prefix to next_prefix joined with ""
            say prefix

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say 0
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        if count is 0:
            say 0
        otherwise:
            let first_input be ask for a number ""
            let previous be value of first_input
            let current_run be 1
            let longest_run be 1
            repeat (count - 1) times:
                let next_input be ask for a number ""
                let current be value of next_input
                if current is more than previous:
                    set current_run to current_run + 1
                    if current_run is more than longest_run:
                        set longest_run to current_run
                otherwise:
                    set current_run to 1
                set previous to current
            say longest_run

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say 0
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        if count is 0:
            say 0
        otherwise:
            let first_input be ask for a number ""
            let previous be value of first_input
            let current_run be 1
            let longest_run be 1
            repeat (count - 1) times:
                let next_input be ask for a number ""
                let current be value of next_input
                if current is more than previous:
                    set current_run to current_run + 1
                    if current_run is more than longest_run:
                        set longest_run to current_run
                otherwise:
                    set current_run to 1
                set previous to current
            say longest_run

to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let k_input be ask for a number ""
    if n_input is nothing:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        if k_input is nothing:
            say ""
        otherwise:
            let n be value of n_input
            let k be value of k_input
            let values be an empty list of number
            repeat n times:
                let value_input be ask for a number ""
                if value_input is nothing:
                    add 0 to values
                otherwise:
                    add (value of value_input) to values
            let results be an empty list of text
            let window_sum be 0
            for each i from 1 to k:
                set window_sum to window_sum + item i of values
            add (window_sum as text) to results
            if n is more than k:
                for each i from k + 1 to n:
                    set window_sum to window_sum + item i of values - item (i - k) of values
                    add (window_sum as text) to results
            say results joined with ","

to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let k_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let k be value of k_input
    let values be an empty list of number
    repeat n times:
        let value_input be ask for a number ""
        add (value of value_input) to values
    let sums be an empty list of text
    for each start from 1 to (n - k + 1):
        let window_sum be 0
        for each offset from 0 to (k - 1):
            set window_sum to window_sum + item (start + offset) of values
        add (window_sum as text) to sums
    say sums joined with ","

import sys


def main() -> None:
    data = sys.stdin.buffer
    n = int(data.readline())
    k = int(data.readline())
    values = [int(data.readline()) for _ in range(n)]

    window_sum = sum(values[:k])
    sums = [str(window_sum)]

    for index in range(k, n):
        window_sum += values[index] - values[index - k]

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        if count is more than 0:
            let counts be a map from text to number
            repeat count times:
                let name be ask ""
                if counts contains name:
                    set item name of counts to (item name of counts) + 1
                otherwise:
                    set item name of counts to 1
            let names be keys of counts
            let winner be item 1 of names
            let winning_count be item winner of counts
            for each i from 2 to length of names:
                let name be item i of names
                let name_count be item name of counts
                if name_count is more than winning_count:
                    set winner to name
                    set winning_count to name_count
            let output_parts be an empty list of text
            add winner to output_parts
            add winning_count as text to output_parts
            say output_parts joined with " "

    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let shift_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        if count is 0:
            say ""
        otherwise:
            let shift be value of shift_input
            let words be an empty list of text
            repeat count times:
                let word be ask ""
                add word to words
            let rotated be an empty list of text
            let quotient be floor of (shift / count)
            let offset be shift - (quotient * count)
            for each index from 1 to count:
                let source_index be index + offset
                if source_index is more than count:
                    set source_index to source_index - count
                add item source_index of words to rotated
            say rotated joined with "|"
